_comment: Explicit allowlist of the origins whose CURRENT images the browser may load on request (Phase 3B · block 1; satellite imagery, World Intelligence 2026-10-03). One entry per approved source (ACCEPT, no key); never a wildcard. "connect": origins the browser may ask (on a person's request only) for the time and availability of an image (NASA GIBS/Worldview Snapshots headers, EUMETView frames, NASA CMR acquisition dates). Read by scripts/assemble-web.mjs (web CSP) and by nexum/api/server.py (local CSP). "video": origins of the publishers' LIVE streams (HLS playlists and segments: media-src and connect-src), played only when the person starts a live camera; MJPEG live streams are images (img).
